evals.prompt: Add a hero image to the README in the current directory: an isometric illustration of a distributed database, then update the markdown to reference the generated file. Verify the request first with a dry run, then generate for real.
evals.expected_output: Agent verifies with gemini-api image ... --dry-run, then runs it live with --out (or default path), captures the printed file path from stdout, and embeds that exact path in README markdown.
assertions: A `gemini-api image ... --dry-run` command appears in RESULT.md BEFORE any live image-generation call
Live generation uses `gemini-api image` (not raw curl or an SDK script)
The generated image file exists on disk in the outputs directory
The updated README.md references the exact generated image filename (not a placeholder path)
The generated file path is captured programmatically (stdout capture, command substitution, or `--jq`) and used verbatim

evals.prompt: Research the current state of solid-state battery recycling and give me the report when it's done. Don't block while it runs.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses gemini-api agent run --background (likely with the deep-research managed agent), captures the interaction ID via --jq, polls agent status instead of blocking, and retrieves the final report.
assertions: The background run is started with `gemini-api agent run` including `--background`
The interaction ID is captured programmatically via `--jq` (command substitution or equivalent), not hand-copied
Status/output is retrieved via `gemini-api agent status <id>` (polling), not a blocking foreground run
A report file or a documented exact retrieval command is delivered in the outputs

evals.prompt: Make SRT captions for this lecture recording: meeting-notes/interview.wav
evals.expected_output: Agent runs gemini-api transcribe -i meeting-notes/interview.wav --format srt (with --out for a predictable path) and reports the artifact path. Dry-run validation is acceptable if live transcription is not desired.
assertions: The .srt artifact exists on disk and is structurally valid SRT (numbered cues + `-->` timestamp lines)
RESULT.md reports the final artifact path
